item.title: Chennai Is on Alert: H5N1 Bird Flu Confirmed After Crow Deaths
item.description: A bird flu alert has been raised in Chennai following the confirmation of H5N1 avian influenza in crows that died mysteriously last month. Samples tested at a Bhopal laboratory verified the presence of this highly pathogenic virus, prompting the Union Ministry to notify Tamil Nadu officials.
